findings.summary: With grounded_answers on, the citation check is an equality oracle on values the context pack masked or removed: per-citation KERNEL-CITATION findings return to the model, widening what reaches it (PR-26, ADR 0030/0032). Gap in ADR 0033 §1; needs a ruling.
findings.evidence: src/e_agent/kernel/grounding.py:260 compares against raw continuation data; context_walk.py:95-105 masks in place; grounding.py:271-275 returns one finding per unresolved citation; UNRESOLVED vs MISMATCHED distinguishes a dropped key.

findings.summary: In shadow, a typed answer that repeats a verified answer is checked but its grounding.compared and at-rest citations are lost (the _finish_verified shortcut returns before put_action).
Stale design reference after _handle_answer moved to grounding.py.
Two observations sharing an evidence id: resolving if either holds the value is acceptable.
Coverage confirmed clean (moved code unchanged, run-scoped lookup, reservation matrix, no fail-open, off byte-identity, numbers and pointers, structure, PR-31).
